App details

GPS Speedometer

See your GPS speed, distance and journey time on a large, clear display.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Large GPS speed display with current, maximum and average speed, distance, elapsed time, signal-quality feedback and an optional mirrored display.

Main features

  • Current, maximum and average speed.
  • Kilometres per hour, miles per hour or knots.
  • Distance, elapsed time and moving time.
  • GPS quality indicator and optional mirrored display.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Speed, movement statistics and display modes

Current GPS speed

Allow location access, start a session and read the large current-speed display. Choose km/h, mph or knots (kt); changing units keeps the same session. Stop ends the measurement, and Reset clears its statistics. Speed comes from valid location data, not an online map.

Maximum, averages, distance and time

See maximum accepted speed, distance travelled, total session time and time moving. Overall average includes the full session; moving average uses only movement distance/time. Poor or unrealistic position jumps are excluded rather than adding false distance or an inflated maximum.

Signal quality and stable readings

Read the GPS quality and reported horizontal accuracy alongside speed. Missing position means acquiring/unavailable, not a confident zero. Smoothing helps readability and stationary-noise filtering reduces false small speeds while stopped. Accuracy depends on the device and signal; missing accuracy is not shown as zero uncertainty.

Large display, mirror mode and screen-awake

HUD mode offers a simple large speed display. Mirror mode flips it for reading through reflection in suitable conditions; visibility varies with windshield and light. Optionally keep the screen awake during an active measurement, then release that setting outside the session.

Local session without route history

The current session uses location only for the active speedometer. It needs no online map or JN86 account and does not keep a route-point list or travel history. Brief interruptions can resume from valid saved state; uncertain gaps are not invented as travelled sections.

Speed-camera joke

Tap the About logo seven times: a drawn speedometer accelerates, a camera flash appears, then the speed falls with a joke about slowing too late. The offline animation uses no GPS and is not a real speed-camera detector.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
